answer.text:
Comcast’s fiscal 2024 operating income margin was **18.8%**.

Calculation: Operating income ÷ Revenue = **$23,297 million ÷ $123,731 million × 100 = 18.82%**, rounded to one decimal place.

Source: Comcast 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0001166691-25-000011**, “Consolidated Statements of Income,” chunk **31**.
